channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Candidatos a presidente intensificam gravações a nove dias do início da propaganda em rádio e televisão
item.description: Nine days before the start of free electoral propaganda on radio and TV, the four candidates with allocated broadcast time (Lula, Flávio Bolsonaro, Ronaldo Caiado, and Augusto Cury) are intensifying their recordings. Lula leads with 44.3% of airtime, followed by Flávio Bolsonaro with 34.7%. Renan Santos and Romeu Zema will have no TV time and will rely on debates and social media.

item.title: Organizador do show de Zezé di Camargo sobre data 12+1: "Ideia minha"
item.description: Alcidon Neto of Aé Eventos said the decision to advertise the Zezé Di Camargo show date as '12+1 November' came from the production team, not the singer's staff. The concert, set for November 13 in Rio Verde, Goiás, has sold over 90% of its tables and was announced before the election season. The unusual date format drew online attention due to its link to the number 13, associated with the PT and Lula, in a city where Bolsonaro received 61.9% of the vote in 2022.

item.title: Flávio aciona TSE contra Janones por acusação de fraude em filiação
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) filed a complaint with the TSE against André Janones (Rede-MG) for falsely claiming the senator paid someone to change his party affiliation to Missão. Janones linked the episode to the 2018 stabbing and used aggressive rhetoric. The Federal Police opened an investigation into the affiliation fraud that temporarily blocked Flávio's candidacy registration.

item.title: Caiado diz que se eleito vai enviar PEC que limita despesas ao crescimento do PIB
item.description: PSD candidate Ronaldo Caiado proposes a constitutional amendment to cap public spending growth at 40-50% of GDP growth. He criticizes the 6x1 work scale PEC as populist and attacks rivals Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro over corruption scandals. A Quaest poll shows Caiado at 4% voter intention.

item.title: Marçal chama Renan Santos de “Lula 2.0”: “Vai ter 1%”
item.description: Pablo Marçal (PRTB) attacked Renan Santos, candidate for Missão, calling him "Lula 2.0" and predicting he will get only 1% in the election. Marçal criticized Santos for not having completed college. The statement was made during a Brasil Paralelo sabatina.

item.title: PF abre inquérito para investigar filiação de Flávio Bolsonaro ao Missão
item.description: The Federal Police opened an inquiry into senator Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL-RJ) affiliation with the Missão party after his campaign failed to register his candidacy in the TSE system. The court suspended the affiliation system and ordered his return to PL to secure candidacy registration.

item.title: A nova pesquisa Quaest sobre a disputa Lula x Flávio no maior colégio eleitoral do Brasil
item.description: The Quaest poll will conduct 1,800 interviews in São Paulo from August 21-24, testing two presidential scenarios for 2026 with 13 candidates in the first and 12 in the second (excluding Pablo Marçal). It will also measure approval of Lula's government, political identification, and voting intentions for São Paulo governor and senator, including a runoff scenario between Haddad and Tarcísio. Results will be released on August 25.

item.title: Caiado critica Congresso e chama decisões do STF de 'inaceitáveis'
item.description: Presidential pre-candidate Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) called some STF decisions 'unacceptable' and criticized Congress's mandatory amendments during a CNT event in Brasília.

item.title: Lulinha, Dark Horse, Banco Master: inquéritos alimentam campanhas, mas só terminam após eleições
item.description: Investigations into Lulinha, Dark Horse, and Banco Master fuel polarization in Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro's campaigns but are unlikely to conclude before the October 2026 elections. Leaks and mutual suspicions serve as electoral ammunition, though authorities expect political rather than legal impact this year, with votes largely settled and limited room for change.

item.title: Caiado evita declarar posição sobre fim da escala 6x1, mas diz que PEC no Congresso é 'medida eleitoreira'
item.description: Presidential candidate Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) avoided taking a stance on the PEC proposing an end to the 6x1 work scale, calling it 'electoralist' and populist. He stated he does not vote in Congress and the issue is not his agenda. Senate President Davi Alcolumbre announced the proposal's processing after talks with President Lula.

item.title: Moraes e Dino defendem a volta de regra da ditadura militar de 1969 para regulamentar o jornalismo
item.description: Supreme Court justices Alexandre de Moraes and Flávio Dino allegedly encouraged the left to support the return of a 1969 military dictatorship rule restricting press freedom, drawing criticism over democratic backsliding.

item.title: Eleições 2026: Candidaturas indígenas batem recorde, mas ainda representam menos de 1%
item.description: The 2026 elections saw a record number of Indigenous candidacies, with 191 applicants out of 20,506 total requests, accounting for under 1% of all candidates. This marks a nearly 3% increase from 2022 and a roughly 125% rise since 2014, spanning 26 federal units and 64 ethnic groups, led by the Macuxi and Guarani Kaiowá peoples.

item.title: Alvo do MPF por fala contra indígenas, Renan Santos chama ação de 'bizarra' e refuta retratação: 'Essa farra vai acabar'
item.description: Presidential candidate Renan Santos (Missão party) was targeted by the Federal Public Prosecutor's Office for statements deemed discriminatory against indigenous people in Baixo Tapajós. He called the action 'bizarre', refused to apologize, and vowed to create a parliamentary inquiry to investigate NGOs and alleged indigenous groups he claims are sabotaging Brazil.

item.title: Candidato a suplente é intimado a trocar foto de Jesus Cristo na urna
item.description: Senate substitute candidate Dilcon Afonso Santos Carvalho (DC-PI) was ordered by the Regional Electoral Court to replace his ballot photo where he appears dressed as Jesus Christ. Electoral rules require a recent, front-facing photo without scenic props. The ticket criticized the decision, comparing it to President Lula's photo wearing a hat, but said it will comply and appeal.

item.title: STF decide ampliar Lei Maria da Penha a casos sem vínculo doméstico
item.description: The STF unanimously expanded the Maria da Penha Law to cover gender-based violence outside domestic settings. Justice Edson Fachin's ruling establishes that urgent protective measures apply to all gender-based violence regardless of family ties. The decision originated from a Minas Gerais case where a neighbor/ex-partner threatened a woman, and lower courts denied protection due to lack of prior cohabitation.

item.title: Caiado critica reciprocidade aos EUA e diz que governo cria "factoide"
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado criticizes Lula's foreign policy, calling reciprocity against US tariffs a 'manufactured controversy' with no real leverage. He urges focus on domestic issues — economy, healthcare, and business closures — rather than diplomatic conflicts with Argentina, the US, and Paraguay.

item.title: Augusto Cury promete indicar duas mulheres ao STF se for eleito presidente
item.description: Presidential candidate Augusto Cury (Avante) pledged to appoint two women to the Supreme Court if elected, praising women's importance in governance and citing IMF data on productivity gains. He also highlighted gender inequalities in pay, interest rates, and femicide rates. Notably, his party was recently penalized for failing to meet gender quota requirements.

item.title: TRE-SP mantém multa de R$ 15 mil contra Lula por campanha antecipada
item.description: The São Paulo Regional Electoral Court upheld a R$15,000 fine against President Lula for early campaigning for Simone Tebet and Marina Silva during an official government event in May.

item.title: Quem são os candidatos ao governo de Rondônia (RO) nas eleições 2026
item.description: Six men will contest Rondônia's governorship in 2026: Hildon Chaves (União Brasil), Marcos Rogério (PL), Adailton Fúria (PSD), Expedito Netto (PT), Samuel Costa (PSB), and Pedro Abib (MDB). Incumbent Marcos Rocha cannot seek re-election due to term limits. Marcos Rogério leads polls with Flávio Bolsonaro's backing, while Adailton Fúria also polls strongly.

item.title: Amiga de Lulinha diz que ‘sócio’ de Nunes Marques atuaria em contrato de cannabis com o governo
item.description: Lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger negotiated a medicinal cannabis contract with the federal government involving Lulinha, President Lula's son, seeking 20% profit. PF dialogues mention attorney Otto Medeiros as "partner" of Justice Kassio Nunes Marques (STF/TSE), who denies partnership but confirms friendship. Investigations probe influence peddling and leaks.

item.title: Tarcísio x Haddad: nova pesquisa Quaest mede a corrida pelo governo de SP
item.description: Quaest has filed a new electoral poll with the TSE for the 2026 elections in São Paulo, scheduled to conduct 1,800 interviews between August 21 and 24, with results set for release on August 25. The survey will gauge voter intention for governor (including first‑round and potential runoff scenarios between Fernando Haddad and Tarcísio de Freitas, plus other contenders), for the two Senate seats (testing 15 candidates), and will also assess approval of the Lula and Tarcísio governments, as well as presidential scenarios with and without Pablo Marçal.

item.title: Jerônimo pede à Justiça retirada de vídeo que associa Lula a ACM Neto, rival do petista na disputa pelo governo baiano
item.description: Jerônimo Rodrigues' campaign requested the Electoral Court to remove a video encouraging split-ticket voting for Lula for president and ACM Neto (União Brasil) for Bahia governor. The TRE-BA denied the injunction, ruling the video as an individual voter expression, but ordered Meta to identify the account holder. The case will proceed on its merits.

item.title: TSE fecha acordo com OpenAI, dona do ChatGPT, para as eleições; saiba detalhes
item.description: The TSE signed a memorandum of understanding with OpenAI, owner of ChatGPT, aimed at the 2026 elections. Company representatives visited the court to formalize the partnership. Full details are subscriber-only.

item.title: Renan Santos, Van Hattem e Jones Manoel lideram “vaquinha coletiva”
item.description: Renan Santos, Marcel Van Hattem, and Jones Manoel lead crowdfunding on the Queroapoiar platform for the 2026 Brazilian elections, raising about R$2.5 million total. Presidential candidate Renan Santos collected R$1.24 million (88% of his goal), followed by Senate candidate Van Hattem with R$722,800 and federal deputy candidate Jones Manoel with R$558,000.

item.title: Reciprocidade contra os EUA não sai antes de dezembro, diz ministro
item.description: Minister Márcio Elias Rosa stated that the commercial reciprocity process against the US will not finish before December, as the government needs time to assess the impact of American tariffs. He called the tariffs illegal and abusive, affecting 47% of Brazilian exports, and rejected linking negotiations to Brazil's 2026 electoral calendar.

item.title: Lulinha processa Zema por vídeo feito com IA
item.description: Businessman Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha) filed a lawsuit in São Paulo against presidential pre-candidate Romeu Zema (Novo party), demanding removal of an AI-generated video depicting him in a marijuana plantation. The action was reported by newspaper O Fator.

item.title: Michelle Bolsonaro monta equipe jurídica de campanha com nomes indicados por Damares
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro (PL) assembled a legal team for her Senate campaign in the Federal District with lawyers connected to the Republicanos party, recommended by Senator Damares Alves. Flávio Britto and Carla Rodrigues, who handled Damares' 2022 campaign, now work for the former first lady while maintaining ties to Republicanos and its president Marcos Pereira.

item.title: Os 18 acessos de Lulinha ao Palácio do Planalto
item.description: Businessman Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, President Lula's son, recorded 18 entries to the Presidential Palace between June 2023 and January 2025, according to data obtained by O Globo via FOIA.

item.title: Brasil pede "diálogo" na OEA para lidar com situação na Nicarágua
item.description: Brazil advocated for dialogue and a technical approach at the OAS regarding Nicaragua's crisis, being the sole country to vote against an emergency foreign ministers' meeting. Ambassador Benoni Belli argued diplomatic channels in the Permanent Council weren't exhausted, while 29 nations approved the meeting to discuss potential constitutional changes blocking opposition participation in Nicaraguan elections.

item.title: Flávio posta vídeo de sunga e faixa presidencial com estética de GTA 6
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) shared an AI-generated video showing him in swimwear and presidential sash with GTA 6 aesthetics. The post on X went viral for days while his campaign declined to comment on its intent, despite coinciding with peak interest in the game's release.

item.title: ACM Neto nega incentivar voto casado com Lula e reafirma apoio a Caiado
item.description: Bahia gubernatorial candidate ACM Neto (União Brasil) denied encouraging a 'split ticket' vote with President Lula (PT) and reaffirmed his support for Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) for the presidency, stating he will respect his voters' other choices.

item.title: Renan Santos derruba barricada do CV em João Pessoa
item.description: Renan Santos, the Missão party presidential candidate, helped dismantle a barricade linked to the Red Command in João Pessoa, Paraíba, on Wednesday (19). He used the operation to showcase his pledge to fight territorial control by criminal gangs. The move highlights public security as a key theme of his 2026 election campaign.

item.title: Cláudio Castro ‘não vai subir no meu palanque’, diz Douglas Ruas a VEJA
item.description: PL candidate for Rio governor Douglas Ruas said former governor Cláudio Castro will not join his campaign and advocated a shift in public security policy, focusing on retaking territories from criminal factions and integration with federal forces. He also addressed investigations into the state pension fund and his tenure as Cities Secretary.

item.title: Debaixo do colchão: veja quem são os candidatos que declaram ter milhões em dinheiro vivo
item.description: Eight candidates declared nearly R$ 79 million in cash at the TSE. The largest amount belongs to Luiz Teodoro dos Santos (R$ 30 million), followed by Clebio Lopes Jacaré (R$ 11.95 million), who was arrested in 2022 for corruption. Half of the candidates are from the Northeast.

item.title: TRE-SP mantém multa a Lula por pedir voto a Tebet e Marina Silva
item.description: The São Paulo Regional Electoral Court upheld a R$15,000 fine against Lula for early campaign advertising. The president, running for re-election, requested votes for Simone Tebet and Marina Silva for Senate during an official event in May.

item.title: Lula recebe R$ 500 nas primeiras doações
item.description: Lula (PT) and Wilson Grassi (Democrata) are the first presidential candidates to report donations to the Electoral Justice. Lula received R$500, while Grassi donated R$290,000 to his own campaign.

item.title: Como o PT deve explorar o silêncio de Flávio Bolsonaro, que segue sem prestar contas sobre Vorcaro
item.description: The Workers' Party plans to exploit Flávio Bolsonaro's silence over the 'Dark Horse' film financing with Banco Master funds from Daniel Vorcaro. After 90 days since his promise for detailed accounting, the PL presidential candidate has not released a public report. The PT strategy aims to counterattack investigations involving Lula's son and allies, keeping the case prominent in the 2026 presidential race.

item.title: Quem Ciro apoiará na eleição presidencial?
item.description: Ciro Gomes (PSDB), running for governor of Ceará, stated he has not yet decided whom to support in the 2026 presidential election, but ruled out backing Lula (PT) or Flávio Bolsonaro (PL). He mentioned he is discussing the matter with Aécio Neves.

item.title: Lula defende submarino nuclear e diz que Brasil não pode ficar 'de cabeça baixa a vida inteira'
item.description: Lula defends the completion of the Navy's nuclear submarine as a matter of national sovereignty, stating Brazil cannot remain submissive.

item.title: Marqueteiro de Flávio admite repulsa de mulheres a 'jeito' de Bolsonaro: 'É um desafio de comunicação'
item.description: Strategist Duda Lima admits Jair Bolsonaro's "hard" style causes repulsion among women voters, a communication challenge for Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign. Women comprise 52.8% of the electorate, prompting greater involvement of Michelle Bolsonaro. Lima also acknowledges Lula's superior ability to emotionally connect with voters.

item.title: A próxima pesquisa Quaest sobre a disputa entre Haddad e Tarcísio em São Paulo
item.description: Quaest will release a new São Paulo gubernatorial poll on Tuesday (25), based on 1,800 interviews with a 2-point margin of error. A prior Paraná Pesquisas survey shows Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicans) leading with 50% in the first round versus 33.8% for Fernando Haddad (PT), and 53% to 36.9% in a runoff projection.

item.title: Michelle mobiliza aliados no meio evangélico para ajudar campanha de Flávio após desgaste no segmento
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro mobilizes her network of evangelical leaders to support Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential campaign after initial friction. The former first lady uses her contacts in major denominations and personal appearances to reconnect her stepson with the evangelical base, which was shaken by public disputes and revelations about film financing.

item.title: Brasil tem entrada de US$ 851 milhões na semana até 14 de agosto
item.description: Brazil recorded a positive foreign exchange flow of US$851 million in the week through Aug 14, driven by a US$3.5 billion commercial surplus and a US$2.6 billion financial outflow. Year-to-date flow stands at US$21.2 billion positive. Meanwhile, foreign investors pulled R$15.6 billion from the B3 stock exchange in August, the largest outflow since Jan 2022, amid fiscal and electoral concerns.

item.title: Lula fala em “força” para defender interesses do Brasil
item.description: Lula advocates for national sovereignty and leverage in negotiations during visit to Aramar nuclear center, highlighting the nuclear submarine program that will make Brazil the 7th country with such technology. The president makes indirect reference to tensions with Trump ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Lula quer evento com 5.000 mulheres em Belo Horizonte
item.description: Lula's re-election campaign organizes the 'National Women with Lula Meeting' on August 29 in Belo Horizonte, expecting 5,000 participants. The event will address combating femicide, equal pay, women's health, digital violence, and female political participation, organized by First Lady Janja and the PT's National Women's Secretariat.

item.title: Disputa sobre inelegibilidade de Dallagnol volta à justiça paranaense às vésperas da eleição
item.description: The Paraná para Todos coalition filed a new request to impugnate Deltan Dallagnol's Senate candidacy, arguing he is ineligible following TSE and STF rulings. The filing seeks definitive denial of his registration, an expedited judgment without evidence, and liability for abuse of the right to run. It claims Dallagnol's move creates legal insecurity and aims to confuse voters.

item.title: TSE já recebeu 1.103 relatos de irregularidades em campanhas
item.description: As of August 19, 2026, Brazil's Superior Electoral Court received 1,103 reports of electoral campaign irregularities, with content boosting being the most common violation (339 cases). São Paulo recorded the highest number of complaints among states, followed by Pernambuco and Paraná. About 54% of the reports remain under review.

item.title: STF adia julgamento sobre eleições para o governo do RJ
item.description: The STF postponed the judgment on the Rio de Janeiro government succession, keeping Justice Ricardo Couto as interim governor. The score was 4-1 favoring an indirect election by the Legislative Assembly, but ministers prioritized another case. Zanin saw a maneuver by Castro resigning before the TSE ruling; Fux questioned the PSD's standing to file the complaint.

item.title: STF adia julgamento sobre mandato-tampão para governador do Rio
item.description: The STF postponed the judgment on whether to hold direct elections for the interim governorship of Rio de Janeiro, prioritizing a ruling on the Maria da Penha Law. The current score is 4 to 1 in favor of indirect election by the Legislative Assembly.

item.title: Na Bahia, ACM Neto nega ligação com Overclean e promete controladoria estadual independente
item.description: ACM Neto (União Brasil) denied involvement in Operation Overclean and pledged, if elected governor of Bahia, to grant autonomy to the state comptroller's office, staffed by technical experts and free from political interference.
